name: Tinker: Gatling Gun is in the Mechanics tab, not General (#13642)
contract: Issue #13642. Gatling Gun (500213) is learned with Build: Mechsuit (801384, SkillLineAbility row 87469,
SkillLine 102 Mechanics) and had no SkillLineAbility row, so the client filed it under General while every
other Mechsuit ability (801384, 801387, 805372, 801389) sits in SkillLine 102. Row 845, a duplicate of row
12779 (Explosive Trap 13813, SkillLine 50) that differs only in MinSkillLineRank, is repurposed for 500213 at
SkillLine 102, and the client patch streams that row after Gatling Gun is learned through Build: Mechsuit.
Explosive Trap keeps SkillLine 50 through its twin rows 12779 and 10131.
